_comment: LLM + embedding configuration. Empty values fall through. Resolution priority for each field (highest first): CLI flag (e.g. --llm-provider) > matching env var (e.g. NORA_LLM_PROVIDER) > value in this file > built-in default. The legacy LLM fields under environments/<name>.json (model_provider / model_name / model_timeout / embedding_provider / embedding_model) are still honored as a back-compat fallback below this file but are deprecated; prefer setting them here. Optional `providers`: a list of named endpoints the Ask page offers ({id, name, base_url, model, api_key_env, supports_reasoning_control, default_mode}). `name` is what the user sees — say what the infrastructure IS ("130B — DGX"), not its role. `api_key_env` names an env var; never put a key in this committed file. `supports_reasoning_control` is declared, not detected — no OpenAI-compatible endpoint advertises it, and a server may accept `reasoning_effort` and silently ignore it. Absent or empty = no roster, and the single-provider chain above is used unchanged.
